snippet.title: Arcadian Days | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Arcadian Days is a first-person, non-linear immersive sim where you follow the lives of the Dragobete family as they settle into their new household. Explore highly detailed environments, develop the farm and your relationships and become immersed in world like no other.

Wishlist today - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3610170/Arcadian_Days/
